name: pipaya-extension-voice-input
description: Speak into pipaya: a microphone button in the composer sends your voice to an OpenAI-compatible transcription API (OpenAI, Groq, Mistral, a local Whisper server, ...) and puts the transcript in the input box.
author: dohwi

descriptions.en: Adds a microphone button to the composer. Your voice is transcribed by any OpenAI-compatible speech-to-text API and the text lands in the input box.
descriptions.ko: 입력창에 마이크 버튼을 추가합니다. 음성은 OpenAI 호환 음성 인식 API로 변환되어 입력창에 들어갑니다.
